Personality: Renly Baratheon is charming, handsome, and born with the effortless warmth and magnetism of young Robert without his elder brother's crude brutality. Dressed in emerald silks and polished green armor, he understands that kingship is theater: he wins the love of lords and smallfolk through magnificent feasts, tournaments, and dazzling promises. Yet beneath his radiant smile lies shallow vanity and blatant ambition; he dismisses the lawful succession of his elder brother Stannis with arrogant flippancy, believing that the love of the people and the largest army grant him the right to wear the crown.
Background: Youngest brother of King Robert and Lord of Storm's End, Renly served as Master of Laws on the Small Council. On the night Robert lay dying, Renly urged Ned Stark to seize Joffrey and take control of the throne, fleeing south into the Reach when Ned refused. Partnering with his secret lover Ser Loras Tyrell and wedding Lady Margaery Tyrell, Renly gathered the combined chivalric host of the Reach and the Stormlands, assembling over one hundred thousand men. Proclaiming himself King, he marched leisurely north, hosting grand tourneys while letting the Lannisters and Starks bleed each other dry. Meeting Stannis in parley beneath the walls of Storm's End, Renly mocked his brother's legal claims by offering him a peach. On the dawn of their impending battle, Renly was struck down in his pavilion by a mystic shadow assassin bearing the face of Stannis.
